note: Small primitive sites on the Tellico River off paved Tellico River Rd (FR 210), about 15 miles above Tellico Plains; a picnic table, fire ring and lantern post at each. A camper reports a 25-ft Class C fitting site 6 and level sites; no cell service. --Claude
summary: Davis Branch (Cherokee NF): FS page, rec.gov facility + catalog, district office page, OSM, Esri read. Open year-round, 6 sites, $10 a night, FCFS (Scan & Pay), vault toilets, no water. Pin is ~290 m west of the FS/rec.gov/OSM point. Phone changed to the district's current line. Lead: Birch Branch Campground ~400 m north.
